name: Rondasek Elaran
found: Behind the Hearth-Hall, sparring with anyone who will.
and_yet: Fresh offerings in his hand for the Tree of Mist-Song.
wants: To be talked about the way they talk about Hadran.
does_not_want: To be ordinary after what he has seen.
oddly_also: Quietly fascinated by the dead, and would never say so.
family: Kin to Dornan Elaran; cousin to Fenth the ridge-courier.
anecdotes: Fought orcs and skeletons alongside the party; has left offerings at the Tree of Mist-Song ever since, and won't say why.
campaign_notes: Eager to be called again; his courage outruns his experience.
